estimates.assumptions: A medium head of broccoli weighs ~250g including stem; this is the edible portion as typically prepared in stir-fry (florets and tender stem).
Standard garlic clove is ~3g; 4 cloves total ~12g. Calorie value used is for raw garlic.
A medium red chili pepper weighs ~45g when sliced and used whole (edible portion).
A bunch of spring onions typically weighs ~100g trimmed and ready to use.
Grams already supplied in recipe (140g); used typical calorie density for cooked/frozen edamame soya beans.
A typical head of pak choi (bok choy) weighs ~170g; 2 heads total 340g edible leaves and stems.
Grams already supplied in recipe (300g); used typical calorie density for marinated/firm tofu.
